name: LABORATORY REFRIGERATOR
desc: Double-Door Laboratory Refrigerator designed for high-capacity, precise climate-controlled storage of biological products within a strict 2°C to 8°C range. Features a massive 1000-liter SS 304 internal chamber with 8 perforated trays and an advanced microprocessor touch display controller.
principle: The INNOLAB INSTRUMENTS LABORATORY REFRIGERATOR is a high-precision, double-door refrigerated storage system engineered for the safe preservation of temperature-sensitive biological materials within a strict 2°C to 8°C range. It employs a microprocessor-based PID controller with a motorized forced air cooling system to maintain ±0.5°C uniformity across its 1000-liter SS 304 chamber. This unit is indispensable for clinical laboratories, biobanks, and research facilities storing vaccines (e.g., mRNA COVID-19 vaccines, live attenuated influenza vaccines), blood derivatives, sera, plasma, microbiological cultures (e.g., Escherichia coli, Staphylococcus aureus, Lactobacillus), cell culture media (DMEM, RPMI-1640), enzymes, antibodies, and PCR reagents. It complies with WHO vaccine storage guidelines, ISO 13485 quality management, and ASTM E1292 temperature mapping standards, ensuring integrity of biological assays and pharmaceutical stability testing.
sop: Ensure the refrigerator is placed on a level surface with at least 10 cm clearance on all sides for ventilation, and lock the castor wheels.
Connect the power cord to a grounded electrical outlet and switch on the main power supply.
Press the 'SET' button once on the digital touch display controller to enter temperature setpoint mode.
Use the 'UP' and 'DOWN' arrows to adjust to the required target parameter (e.g., 4°C for general storage).
Press 'SET' again to lock the value; the controller will now display the actual chamber temperature and begin cooling.
Allow the unit to stabilize for at least 30 minutes before loading any samples, verifying that the display reads within 2°C to 8°C.
Open the glass doors only when necessary, and load pre-chilled or room-temperature samples onto the perforated SS 304 trays, ensuring adequate spacing for air circulation.
Close the doors firmly and engage the key lock to prevent unauthorized access.
Monitor the temperature display regularly; if an alarm sounds (e.g., temperature deviation, door ajar), address the issue immediately.
For data logging, connect via USB, WiFi, Ethernet, RS232, or RS485 as per laboratory protocol to record temperature trends.

Safety Warning: Never store flammable or explosive chemicals (e.g., ether, acetone) in this refrigerator, as the electrical components may ignite vapors; only store compatible biological and chemical reagents as specified by the manufacturer.
